name: Inomin Mines Inc.
summary: Inomin Mines Inc., an exploration stage company, engages in the identification, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for gold, silver, copper, nickel, cobalt, and zinc deposits. It holds a 100% interest in the King's Point polymetallic project comprising 129 claims that covers an area of 3,225 hectares within two separate blocks located in the Green Bay area of Newfoundland; and the Fleetwood zinc-copper-silver-gold property located in the New Westminster Mining Division of southwestern British Columbia. The company also holds a 100% interest in the Beaver Nickle-Cobalt property comprising an area of 7,528 hectares; the Lynx Nickel property covering an area of 12,662 hectares located in British Columbia; and La Gitana and Pena Blanca Gold-Silver Projects located in Mexico. Inomin Mines Inc. has a strategic alliance with Turnagain Resources Inc. on Fleetwood-Seneca zinc-copper-silver-gold properties. The company was formerly known as Inovent Capital Inc. Inomin Mines Inc. was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
